extracted.name: Quick Strawberry Oatmeal Breakfast Smoothie
extracted.description: Blend almond milk, oats, strawberries, and yogurt together to make this recipe for a fast and filling strawberry oatmeal breakfast smoothie.
instruction_lines: Blend oats and chia seeds together in a blender to a fine consistency. Add strawberries, yogurt, banana, almond milk, and vanilla extract; blend until smooth.
